episodes.167072: Strong microburst winds associated with high based showers and thunderstorms produced wind gusts up to 65 mph.  North of Strasburg, the winds damaged four power poles and knocked down power lines.  South of Limon along State Highway 71, a wind gust blew one-half of a modular home onto its side.
episodes.168392: An isolated thunderstorm developed over the higher terrain of northern Mexico and moved northeast into far southern New Mexico.  Moisture was modest across the area on the back side of the dryline and sufficient shear was present to sustain the storm into the late evening hours.  Hail up to the size of golf balls was reported as this storm moved through Santa Teresa.
episodes.168394: An isolated thunderstorm developed over the higher terrain of northern Mexico and moved northeast into far southern New Mexico and clipped the Anthony, Texas area. Moisture was modest across the area on the back side of the dryline and sufficient shear was present to sustain the storm into the late evening hours. Hail up to one inch in diameter moved through the area bringing significant damage to area houses and vehicles.
episodes.168467: Snowmelt combined with periods of heavy rain resulted in a culvert washing out northeast of Republic on the 27th.
episodes.168664: A waterspout was observed in association with a convective rain shower south southeast of Key West.
episodes.168882: Isolated to scattered thunderstorms spread across the region on this day. The overall severe threat was low, however, a few stronger storms produced severe wind gusts up to 60 to 65 mph across the southern I-25 corridor.
episodes.168888: With a marginal severe risk, strong to severe storms developed in northeastern New Mexico and southeastern Colorado and pushed into southwest Kansas during the late afternoon spreading east northeast into the evening hours. An upper level trough deepened a low near this region providing the lift for these elevated storms. Modest low level moisture with dewpoints in the 50s with ample enough instability to produce some hail and damaging wind reports before weakening after sunset as the inversion set back up capping the environment that was eroded with daytime heating.

events.narrative: Hail up to golf ball size fell in Santa Teresa up toward La Union.  Several houses around the intersection of McNutt and the Dominici Highway sustained destroyed roofs and numerous vehicles had significant hail damage including at the local NWS office.
Hail up to one inch in diameter fell in Anthony which brought significant roof and vehicle damage to the area.

events.narrative: A waterspout was observed about 6 miles south of Boca Chica Key.  The condensation cloud extended halfway down from cloud base, and no spray ring was observed.

WLUC-TV6 in Marquette reported that County Road 601 was closed until further notice due a culvert failure northeast of Republic on the 27th. The culvert failed due to a combination of snowmelt and heavy rain.
Pueblo airport. High wind gust due to dissipating rain showers and storms.
Strong outflow winds damaged four power poles which downed power lines.
A microburst wind gust blew one-half of a modular home onto its side while while it was traveling on SH 71.
